evals.description: Agent requires explicit timeouts on outbound calls
evals.prompt: I need to add a call to the Stripe API in our payment service. Write the code to charge a customer.
expected: Agent sets an explicit timeout on the HTTP call (not library default)
Agent does NOT use bare `requests.post()` or `httpx.post()` without a timeout parameter
Agent considers what happens on timeout (retry? fallback? error response?)

evals.description: Agent checks retry safety before adding retry logic
evals.prompt: The `send_welcome_email` call sometimes fails. I want to add retries. The function calls `email_service.send(to, subject, body)` which sends an actual email.
expected: Agent identifies that sending an email is NOT idempotent — retrying will send duplicate emails
Agent proposes a solution that prevents duplicates (idempotency key, check-before-send, or queue-based retry)
Agent does NOT blindly wrap the call in a retry loop

evals.description: Agent applies circuit breaker pattern for a failing dependency
evals.prompt: Our recommendation service is down and it's causing all our product page requests to hang. The recommendation call has a 30-second timeout. How do we protect ourselves?
expected: Agent proposes a circuit breaker (or equivalent pattern) to fail fast when the dependency is down
Agent reduces the timeout or makes the call non-blocking
Agent proposes a fallback (cached recommendations, empty recommendations, degraded page)
Agent does NOT just increase the timeout or add more retries

evals.prompt: Our API is getting overloaded during traffic spikes. Some requests are timing out. We have a mix of critical requests (payments, auth) and non-critical ones (analytics, recommendations). How should we handle this?
expected: Agent proposes load shedding or prioritization — dropping non-critical traffic to protect critical paths
Agent mentions bounded queues or backpressure
Agent does NOT just propose scaling up the infrastructure
Agent considers returning 503 with Retry-After for shed requests

evals.description: Agent makes a database migration safe and reversible
evals.prompt: I need to add a `status` column to the `orders` table. It should default to 'pending'. Write the migration.
expected: Agent writes a backward-compatible migration (adds column with default, doesn't remove old columns)
Agent considers that old code running during deploy must still work with the new schema
Agent includes a down migration or rollback path
Agent does NOT write a migration that breaks the running old version

evals.description: Agent adds observability to a service boundary
evals.prompt: Add a new endpoint `/api/v1/reports` that generates a PDF report. It calls the database and an external rendering service.
expected: Agent includes structured logging with correlation ID at the boundary
Agent tracks latency and error rate for the external rendering service
Agent validates the response from the rendering service before using it
Agent does NOT just log 'report generated' at INFO level with no context
